one_line: Vedic ritual geometer guiding altar construction with cords and stakes in the northern Indian heartland.

appearance.age_look: Late 40s, lean but sturdy, with the wiry build of someone used to working outdoors.
appearance.face: Oval face with a calm, thoughtful gaze, medium-brown complexion, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, a faint vertical tilak on the forehead, default expression serene and focused as if visualising geometry.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair, shoulder-length and subtly wavy, pulled back into a low, tidy knot at the back of the head; no turban, just a simple off-white cloth band tied around the head like a narrow headband.
appearance.costume: He wears a plain, era-appropriate Vedic-style dhoti in muted off-white cotton, pleated and wrapped securely from waist to ankles, paired with a light saffron-tinged cotton upper cloth (uttariya) draped over the left shoulder and around the torso, leaving both arms fully covered; simple leather sandals on his feet; minimal jewellery consisting of a single strand of small rudraksha-like beads around his neck and a narrow copper bangle on his right wrist; no elaborate patterns, just subtle handwoven texture, with a thin brown border along the dhoti hem and uttariya edge.
appearance.signature: A long measuring cord wound neatly around a smooth wooden peg in his left hand, with two small wooden stakes and a simple rectangular clay tablet with incised lines held together in a sling at his waist, the cord clearly the main focus.

ref_desc: Baudhayana is a lean, late-40s Vedic geometer with medium-brown skin, shoulder-length dark brown hair in a low knot, off-white dhoti, saffron upper cloth, simple beads and copper bangle, holding a long measuring cord wrapped on a wooden peg in earthy browns.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model of Baudhayana: a lean, late-40s Vedic ritual geometer with an oval, medium-brown face, calm focused eyes, straight nose, and short neatly trimmed beard and moustache, marked by a faint vertical tilak. His dark brown, shoulder-length wavy hair is tied into a low knot at the back, with a narrow off-white cloth band around his head. He wears a plain, off-white cotton dhoti wrapped and pleated from waist to ankles, and a light saffron-tinged cotton upper cloth (uttariya) draped around his torso and over his left shoulder, both arms modestly covered, plus simple leather sandals. Add a single strand of small brown beads at his neck and a narrow copper bangle on his right wrist. His signature prop is a long measuring cord wound carefully around a smooth wooden peg in his left hand, with two small wooden stakes and a simple rectangular clay tablet with incised lines hanging in a small sling at his waist; keep the textiles subtly textured, mostly solid off-white and saffron with thin brown borders, and emphasize the earthy palette of off-white, saffron, medium and dark browns in a clean, heroic, historically grounded anime design.
